Trs.

BG_Child
Gable is a human child. He wants to visit the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.
“
The monster thing is scary. Will you go first? Thanks.
„
— Gable

Involvement

Act Three

Gable is just outside the entrance to the circus. Gable wishes to see  Dribbles, but is afraid of  Benji. His father  Emmet tries to encourage him to enter, claiming that Benji is just a man in a costume, but Gable is not convinced.

Idle banter

  • Gable
    Dad, what's that monster?
  • Emmet
    That's just a man in a costume. It's not real.
  • Gable
    But costumes don't drool, dad.
  • Emmet
    You want to see Dribbles the Clown, don't you?
  • Gable
    Yeah...
  • Emmet
    Then let's go inside - don't be scared.
  • Gable
    Do you think Dribbles will have his animal friends with him?
  • Emmet
    Of course - he never travels without his friends. Let's go!
  • Gable
    But the creepy monster thing...
